## About
Cabrales Auto Repair is family owned and operated, and the owner is on site. We work on all major car brands and keep our prices fair, so you can bring your car here knowing it's in trustworthy hands.
We try to turn repairs around quickly and get you back on the road safely. Some jobs take longer, so we keep a clean waiting room with hot gourmet coffee, cold refreshments and snacks while you wait.
Neighbors have rated us 4.5 on Google across 106 reviews. One customer said we're the most reliable and trustworthy shop they've had.

## Services
- Brakes: Squeaking or grinding when you stop? We handle brakes and anti-lock brakes.
- Check engine light: One reviewer came in with a check engine light on, and Junior and Joe took care of it so they passed their emissions test.
- Heating and Cooling Services: Thermostats, water pumps, radiators and heater cores.
- Shocks and Struts: Undercar work to keep your ride steady over the bumps.
- Hoses and Belts: Worn hoses and belts checked and replaced.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open weekdays and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: We service all major car brands.

Q: Can I get less expensive parts?
A: Yes. Our customers asked, so along with our top of the line parts we now offer an economy line. Just ask us about it when you stop by.
